items.equations: Eg=hc/(q*lambda); independent Newton root; fixed-x warm gap; residual=measured-predicted
items.review_notes: Root uses the supplied empirical relation only; residual alone does not diagnose gradients.
dEg/dx includes -0.00107T; dLambda/dT negative here; x is dimensionless.
The empirical positive temperature slope follows 1-2x, not a universal gap trend.
Four-terminal bulk geometry; equal ohmic contacts; two-terminal intercept interpretation is conditional.
Independent relative variances sum; covariance omitted explicitly.
RH sign from stated polarities; rH in both density and drift-mobility conversion.

items.equations: Two-carrier low-field conductivity/Hall formula supplied; q=1.602176634e-19 C
items.review_notes: Mobility-squared weighting determines Hall sign; single-carrier inversion invalid.
Parallel electron/hole conductivity; uniform electrical cross-section.
Transit=L²/(muV); lifetime independent; bias voltage active, low-field reinjection model.
External generation probability excludes gain; responsivity alone does not identify microscopic lifetime.
Phase -45deg fixes omega*tau=1; phenomenological pole not a unique recombination channel.

items.equations: Independent Norton PSDs 4kBT/R sum; multiply by R_parallel2
items.review_notes: Independent Norton PSDs at distinct temperatures; output sees parallel resistance.
Poisson dark/background shot sources plus Johnson/readout PSDs; divide ASD by Ri for NEP density.

items.equations: One-sided PSD=2*two-sided positive-frequency PSD; ASD=sqrt(PSD); variance=S_one*positive_bandwidth
items.review_notes: One-sided PSD is doubled; ASD sqrt2; positive band integrated once.
Integrate PSD not ASD; finite lower frequency cutoff; log colored variance.

items.equations: After subtracting white: ratio=2.5=(1+4z)/(1+z), z=1; variance=S0*pi*fc/2
items.review_notes: White plateau subtracted before ratio inversion; GR integrated over positive frequencies.
Independent Lorentzian variances summed, not RMS; same one-sided convention.
Two identical cascaded pole magnitudes squared: ENBW=1/(8tau), post-mixer convention supplied.
Unequal-pole partial-fraction integral 1/[4(tau1+tau2)].

items.equations: Composite Simpson 8192 panels of PSD*|H|2; unfiltered analytic log integral
items.review_notes: Colored PSD weighted by true filter; independently verified analytic antiderivative.

items.equations: Square-wave difference dP: fundamental peak=2*dP/pi; RMS=peak/sqrt2
items.review_notes: Square wave fundamental peak=2*dP/pi; RMS=peak/sqrt2; DC mean distinct.
Explicit Norton parallel output model; AC bias reference grounded, load shunts defined output.
mm² to cm² factor .01; no bandwidth factor for density NEP.

items.equations: tauRC=R*C; solve cascade amplitude; phases add with omega=2*pi*f
items.review_notes: R*C de-embedded from product of pole magnitudes; phases add in radians then degrees.
Magnitude/phase imply inconsistent pole times; timing offsets and multiple poles remain possible.

items.equations: Planck SI B_lambda; multiply by 1e-6 for per-um radiance
items.review_notes: Planck per-m to per-um factor 1e-6; differential temperature not optical calibration.

items.equations: Composite Simpson Planck integral; Omega_projected=pi*sin2(theta); P=A*t*Omega*band_radiance
items.review_notes: Band integration in metres; pi*sin²(theta) is projected solid angle, no extra pi.
Exact defined cone tan(theta)=1/(2F); paraxial overestimate 1/(4F²).

items.equations: Common emissivity cancels; solve B_lambda(8um,T)/B_lambda(12um,T)=observed; high-T B_lambda proportional T/lambda4
items.review_notes: Common emissivity cancels; Planck ratio monotone on bracket; Rayleigh-Jeans lambda^-4.

items.equations: Photon spectral radiance=B_lambda*lambda/(hc); integrate in metres; I=q*eta*photon_rate
items.review_notes: Photon radiance integrates B_lambda*lambda/(hc), external QE applied after optical transmission.
cm lengths consistently; collection probability reduces external QE below absorbed incident fraction.
Common surface factor cancels between logarithmic transmission ratios; no back reflection.
Gain-free external QE uses incident power; responsivity=q*eta*lambda/(hc).
Apparent gain-enhanced EQE differs from generation efficiency; bias supplies energy.

items.equations: log NEP=e-R; log Dstar=.5*logA-logNEP; independent fractional variances sum
items.review_notes: Dstar has half the fractional area coefficient; independent calibration covariance assumed absent.
Hall-factor, density and geometry errors all explicit; two-carrier bias is not covered by variance.
T² prefactor removed before slope; apparent activation energy not unique mechanism.

items.equations: Geometry slope=rho/S; intercept=2Rc; common shift changes intercept under model
items.review_notes: R versus length slope gives rho; intercept gives two equal Rc, geometry/model conditional.

items.equations: Z=V/I; same current with doubled readout gain explains doubled voltage
items.review_notes: Dummy-injection readout gain change explains voltage change; detector current unchanged.

items.equations: sigma=q*n*mu; R=L/(sigma*Wt); transit=L2/(muV); g=tau/transit; Ri=eta*g*q*lambda/(hc); SI=4kBT/R+readout2; Dstar=sqrt(A_cm2)/NEP
items.review_notes: Optical area L*W differs from electrical W*t; density NEP and Jones sqrtcm area; only declared noise sources.
